evidence_spans: The combined power of the cUFS, TECU, and PIM components is approximately 3.23 W, comparable to the approximately 3.27 W of near-Flash logic per package in [64].
Based on the energy/power models described above and the simulator configuration, we simulate workload execution and derive the average runtime power consumption.
